_metadata.description: Catalog enumeration and PRD status tracking requirements

requirements.title: Catalog enumerates all scenarios and resources with PRD status
requirements.description: Verifies GET /api/v1/catalog returns complete list of entities by globbing scenarios/*/PRD.md and resources/*/PRD.md, detecting draft presence, and extracting descriptions.

validation.notes: TestHandleGetCatalog validates catalog API endpoint integration
End-to-end validation of catalog enumeration and navigation workflow

requirements.title: Published PRD viewer renders markdown correctly
requirements.description: Confirms GET /api/v1/catalog/{type}/{name} returns PRD content with proper markdown formatting.

validation.notes: E2E validation of navigation to PRD detail view

requirements.title: Catalog displays accurate status badges for each entity
requirements.description: Ensures UI renders ✅ Has PRD, ⚠️ Violations, ❌ Missing, 📝 Draft Pending badges based on API response.

validation.notes: Catalog enumeration tests validate status indicators (has_prd, has_draft, violations)
Catalog API endpoint tests validate status badge data in response
E2E validation of catalog status badges rendering

requirements.title: Catalog supports search and filter operations
requirements.description: Confirms search input filters entities by name/type and UI updates reactively.

validation.notes: Catalog tests validate filtering and search logic
Handler tests validate catalog API with query parameter filtering
